document.readableText: A flickering light invades your line of sight. The Machine beckons.
Light. Sound. Heat. The Machine comes to life.
Force liberates The Operator, requiring less Hold to reach max speed.
The Tower walls begin to pulsate as The Machine rages.
An unbreakable Machine. An idle soul.
A new portal. A new voyage. Travel yields knowledge. Knowledge pleases The Machine.
This Machine needs more power. Hurry, Operator.
No machine can match us. Not even...
Warmth: a familiar friend. The Machine will protect you if you protect it.
Matter will accelerate the Machine's evolution.
Steel will allow for more storage. This Tower will be a factory in no time.
Gentle JrBots join the ensemble. They feed The Machine while The Operator is away.
The Machine uses these tokens to establish a connection with the Source.
Scrap metal production is required for evolution. JrBots sacrifice themselves willingly.
Miner-Bots are useful outside of the tower.
Your bruised, callused hands cling to the iron levers. At once they feel healed.
JrBots dive straight into The Core's everlasting light.
Research will yield new methods for increasing the speed of matter output.
Transportation functionality appears near operational. At last.
A portal invites you in. You remember how portals work.
The resources gathered may be compatible with The Machine.
The Machine likes what it's been fed. It rewards The Operator with power.
The Jr Bots. The Machine. The Operator. It starts to feel seamless. They're all connected.
Supercharge, Turbocharge, it doesn't matter. The Machine consumes them either way.
Do not lose track of where The Machine ends and The Operator begins.
Too many Operators have been absorbed by their Machines.
These are promising materials, but they don't compare to...
Is The Machine stronger now than it was before the first voyage?
Surely other Operators have attempted what's being attempted here.
The Desire is too great to imagine only one Operator came looking for it.
Why any Operator would seek any machine besides this one feels but an enigma.
The Machine needs The Operator's energy to evolve.
A new voyage awaits. The Operator will part with the Machine, for the good of The Machine.
The Machine reunites with its Operator. The Operator shares what The Operator saw.
Bizarre. Outside The Tower is a hairless humanoid figure, staring up at The Machine.
The humanoid is back, staring up. They seem capable of transport, just like The Operator.
While The Operator was away, the humanoid destroyed the security JrBots. That beast.
That humanoid used Blasts, Bangs, Portals and more. They couldn't be. An Operator?
It's been weeks since The Machine spoke. Perhaps months?
The Operator has managed to avoid Teleporation Trauma.
Perhaps The Machine is looking out for you.
Silence breaks. The Machine speaks.
Not literally, of course. Such a thing would be ludicrous.
The Machine accesses the hard drive you call a brain.
The Machine asks The Operator to recite their findings.
The Operator begins to remember.
Five Zones, and several quests.
The Operator remembers a time when Slimes posed a threat.
The Titans of the Outskirts are quite the enemies.
The Operator recalls the humanoid that visits The Tower.
The humanoid visitor never enters. They only harvest Evos and leave.
Before all that. There was a reason The Operator came to this place.
The Operator was looking for something. The Desire.
Might the humanoid visitor be searching for the same Desire?
If only there were other Operators to exchange findings with.
Perhaps sharing what was seen in the Portals. If others are out there, that is.
Other Operators may have different perspectives on what's presented itself.
Why do the Nomads, the humanoid, and The Operator look the same?
The Machine's silence is rage inducing.
The Operator believes that in time, a portal will lead to The Desire.
The Operator recalls the hooded figure from voyages. The one who asks to trade.
That hooded figure once spoke about a Market.
The Market is said to contain abilities The Machine can't produce locally.
The Operator looks up at the sweating masterpiece of metal.
The Machine looks back, as if to give its blessing.
The Operator will go to the Market and acquire new strengths.
These new strengths will result in advancement of The Machine.
Advancement of The Machine will surely lead to your Desire.

document.subject: The DrillBot Update
document.body:
The DrillBot Update

- Manufacture DrillBots and bring them with you into portals for big rewards!

- Rebalanced evo/shard portal drops

- Changes to Fuel production time and capacity

- Removed Extract

- Fuel perks and Extract perks no longer function and can now be dusted for 2x Dust

- New free signals and new ad signals

- Shard Pack system removed

- Fixed issue where quest progress did not carry to next quest level

- Other rebalances to discover!

document.subject: What is new in A&M2?
document.body:
What is new in A&M2?

- Season 1: Dagaz is here! Collect season points and earn exclusive rewards.

- Start the season strong with a special offer in the store.

- Keep your machine improving by rebooting your machine with Prestige, now with increased efficiency for upgrading talents that improve your machine.

document.subject: Upgradable Fuel Discovered
document.body:
Fuel speed is now upgradable!

Spend power and M-tokens to produce Fuel faster. The initial Fuel speed has been reduced, but can be upgraded back to, and beyond, what was previously possible.

document.subject: What is new in A&M2?
document.body:
Our newest update is here, lots of new features and changes

- Lost Signals have appeared in your power screen, click them for bonuses.

- Season 2: Odal is live!

- A ton of new production jobs have been added to the core loops.

- Boosters are no more, Shards now perform boosts and all boosters will be converted back to shards.

- Watch out for new offerings in the shop, including the ability to skip ads.

- For the sake of significantly improving the research system, research speed progress had to be reset

- Tons more rebalances and UX improvements to explore
